description: This file defines schemas (data models) using Pydantic for a requirement estimation backend. It includes models related to RateCards and ComplexityDefaults, with create, update, and read variants, complete with validation and metadata annotations.

classes.name: RateCardBase
classes.description: Shared fields for RateCard schemas, including role, hourly rate, and currency, with validation for non-negative hourly rates.

classes.name: RateCardCreate
classes.description: Payload structure for creating a new RateCard, inherits from RateCardBase.

classes.name: RateCardUpdate
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing RateCard, with all fields optional and validation for non-negative hourly rates.

classes.name: RateCardRead
classes.description: Representation of a RateCard returned from the API, including metadata fields like id, created_at, and updated_at.

classes.name: ComplexityDefaultsBase
classes.description: Shared fields for ComplexityDefaults schemas, including item_type, complexity, and default_hours, with validation.

classes.name: ComplexityDefaultsCreate
classes.description: Payload for creating default hours for an item_type/complexity pair, inherits from ComplexityDefaultsBase.

classes.name: ComplexityDefaultsUpdate
classes.description: Payload for updating default hours, all fields optional, with validation.

classes.name: ComplexityDefaultsRead
classes.description: Representation of ComplexityDefaults returned from the API, including metadata fields like id, created_at, and updated_at.

methods.name: Optional[float] validate_rate_non_negative(cls, v: Optional[float])
methods.description: Validator for ensuring hourly_rate fields are non-negative in RateCardBase and RateCardUpdate.

methods.name: Optional[float] validate_hours_non_negative(cls, v: Optional[float])
methods.description: Validator for ensuring default_hours fields are non-negative in ComplexityDefaultsBase and related schemas.
